title: Safe Configuration Tuning knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Safe Configuration Tuning”?
options: Administration requires distinguishing global defaults from session state, startup-only options from dynamic variables, and intended behavior from observed status. Record the before-state and consult the versioned manual before changing settings.
It is a frontend styling feature and does not involve database behavior.
It guarantees correct output regardless of schema, permissions, or release version.
It is best handled by removing constraints and skipping error checks.
questions.answer_key: Administration requires distinguishing global defaults from session state, startup-only options from dynamic variables, and intended behavior from observed status. Record the before-state and consult the versioned manual before changing settings.
questions.explanation: The lesson explains: Administration requires distinguishing global defaults from session state, startup-only options from dynamic variables, and intended behavior from observed status. Record the before-state and consult the versioned manual before changing settings.

questions.prompt: Which practice best applies “Safe Configuration Tuning” safely?
options: Skip testing, assume every SQL engine behaves identically, and apply the change directly to production.
Concatenate untrusted input into SQL text and grant administrator privileges to every application user.
Judge success only by whether the statement returns any rows, without checking expected behavior or edge cases.
Apply Safe Configuration Tuning to a synthetic MySQL lab scenario, write down the expected outcome, and specify how you will verify it safely.
questions.answer_key: Apply Safe Configuration Tuning to a synthetic MySQL lab scenario, write down the expected outcome, and specify how you will verify it safely.
questions.explanation: Apply Safe Configuration Tuning to a synthetic MySQL lab scenario, write down the expected outcome, and specify how you will verify it safely. This makes the result reviewable and aligns with a controlled learning workflow.

questions.prompt: Before relying on an example for “Safe Configuration Tuning”, what should be verified?
options: Ignore version notes and infer behavior from an unrelated database engine.
Assume a successful connection means the query and data model are correct.
Confirm the exact MySQL version and prerequisites, predict the result, run a minimal test in a disposable environment, then inspect the evidence and relevant official documentation.
Run a broad production change before checking the current state.
questions.answer_key: Confirm the exact MySQL version and prerequisites, predict the result, run a minimal test in a disposable environment, then inspect the evidence and relevant official documentation.
questions.explanation: Confirm the exact MySQL version and prerequisites, predict the result, run a minimal test in a disposable environment, then inspect the evidence and relevant official documentation.
